{'text': 'MS NOW 的 Jen Psaki 認為，Donald Trump 星期三在亞利桑那州牛津市（Bullhead City）一場2026年中期選舉競選集會上，作出了「至今最失控嘅演出」。', 'paragraph_context': 'MS NOW’s Jen Psaki argued that Donald Trump delivered "his most unhinged performance" to date at a 2026 midterms campaign rally in Bullhead City, Arizona, on Wednesday.'}

{'text': 'Psaki 聲稱，喺選舉前僅剩幾星期、佢同共和黨嘅民調表現不斷下滑之際，Trump 正面臨「以我哋前所未見嘅速度瓦解」，而且「越講越唔知所謂」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Psaki claimed Trump is now "unraveling at a pace we haven\'t really seen" and "making less and less sense" as he and the GOP suffer poor polling just weeks ahead of the elections.'}

{'text': '佢特別聚焦喺一個瞬間，話呢段係一段「離譜嘅離題」，講嘅係佢隨行嘅醫生會任由一個人喺佢面前死去。', 'paragraph_context': 'She zoomed in on one particular moment, which she described as a "bizarre tangent" about how the doctors he travels with would essentially let someone die in front of him.'}

{'text': 'Trump 話：', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump said:'}

{'text': '「我隨行嘅醫生多過任何⋯⋯如果台下有人病咗，佢哋唔會理，佢哋會放低佢哋唔理。你哋知佢哋點稱呼呢啲人？Collateral damage（附帶損傷）。如果嗰個人，就喺嗰度，我嘅一個朋友，佢睇落真係好差，佢睇落就嚟緊心臟病發。如果佢真係心臟病發，你哋知我嘅醫生會點做？佢要跟住總統或者總統們？佢哋會放低佢唔理。我會話，『拜託救佢。』『唔得呀先生，我哋唔可以離開你身邊。』我話，『但佢就嚟心臟病死啦。』『先生，佢只係附帶損傷。』你哋信唔信呀？」', 'paragraph_context': '"I travel with more doctors than any ... if people get sick in the audience, they don\'t, they leave them alone. You know what they call them? Collateral damage. If that person, right over there, a friend of mine, he looks like shit, actually. He looks like he\'s ready to have a heart attack. If he actually had a heart attack, you know what my doctors would do? They\'d follow the president or presidents? They would leave him alone. I\'d say, \'Please help him.\' \'No, sir. We can\'t leave your side.\' I said, \'But he\'s dying of a heart attack.\' \'Sir. He\'s collateral damage.\' Can you believe it?"'}

{'text': '曾經喺拜登白宮擔任新聞秘書嘅 Psaki，對 Trump 嘅呢番言論感到震驚。', 'paragraph_context': "Psaki, a former Biden White House press secretary, was stunned by Trump's claim."}

{'text': '「對唔住，吓？吓？再講，唔係咁嘅。」佢話。', 'paragraph_context': '"I\'m sorry, what? What? Also, that\'s not what they would do," she said.'}

{'text': 'Psaki 較早時承認，因為「每日從 Trump 口中爆出嘅廢話實在太多」，好容易「當耳邊風」，而且「廢話畢竟係策略嘅一部分」，目的就係轉移視線。', 'paragraph_context': 'Psaki earlier acknowledged it\'s easy "to dismiss whatever nonsense falls out of Trump\'s mouth on a given day" because there\'s so much of it, and "the nonsense is after all part of the strategy" to distract.'}

{'text': '但佢認為，「全國每一場選舉嘅每一位共和黨人都必須要為 Donald Trump 依家所講嘅嘢負責。」', 'paragraph_context': 'But she argued that "every single Republican in every single race in the country should have to answer for the things Donald Trump is saying right now."'}

{'text': '佢隨即列舉咗 Trump 喺今次演說中嘅部分爭議言論，話共和黨人應該要就呢啲言論接受質問，例子包括佢呼籲槍斃洩密者、感謝卡塔爾送佢新空軍一號，以及吹噓高油價其實係好事。', 'paragraph_context': "She then reeled off some of Trump's more controversial comments from the address that she said Republicans should be grilled on, including his call for leakers to be shot, his thanks to Qatar for his new Air Force One and his boast that high oil prices are actually a good thing."}
